contactPage.title: Contact Us
contactPage.subtitle: Official Communication Channel of Celestia
contactPage.description: The PT Mitra Rahim Indonesia marketing team is ready to assist you with inquiries regarding property projects, location survey schedules, and plot consultations.
contactPage.officeAddressNote: For official inquiries and correspondence, please contact the marketing team through the available channels.
contactPage.projectLocationDisclaimer: * Site location is not an official licensing/corporate office.
contactPage.channelDesc: All online communications are currently routed through marketing WhatsApp to ensure candidate customer inquiries are recorded transparently and documented.
contactPage.serviceHoursNotice: Operating hours for Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays may vary. Confirm availability via WhatsApp marketing.
contactPage.ownerMeetingDesc: For prospective clients wishing to consult or meet directly with PT Mitra Rahim Indonesia representatives, please contact the marketing team via WhatsApp to obtain further information and schedule an appointment.
contactPage.marketingDesc: Reach our marketing team via WhatsApp for prompt responses regarding unit information, plot availability, and site survey appointments.
contactPage.interestFormNotice: Looking to submit specific plot preferences or consultation inquiries?
contactPage.faq1Question: How do I schedule a project site survey?
contactPage.faq1Answer: You can reach out to our marketing team via WhatsApp to schedule a guided site visit to the Dehir project in Jatiluhur.
contactPage.faq2Question: Can I book or purchase a plot directly through the website?
contactPage.faq2Answer: Currently, the website serves as a promotional and exploration platform. Reservations, availability verification, and transaction processes are handled directly through official company representatives.
contactPage.faq3Question: Is the unit status shown on the website final?
contactPage.faq3Answer: Units without confirmed company status are labeled 'Unconfirmed' for full transparency. Up-to-date availability can be confirmed directly with marketing.
